sq.QUESTION_DESC: What is the ultimate aim of understanding existence as co-existence?

lq.ANSWER: The Hiware Bazaar practice session shows that society can change when people work together with a common goal, good governance and participation. The village became an example of how individuals can participate in improving society rather than simply blaming the system. The discussion asks us to observe the goal of the village society, the program followed by the people, and the participation of each person. It also helps us reflect on our own family goal, family program and contribution of each member. The session shows that physical facility alone is not enough; right utilisation, responsibility, cooperation and participation are essential. A society based on relationship and co-existence can move toward justice, prosperity and mutual happiness
